declarations.name: AuiFunnelChart

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby). Must not be blank.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

inputs.name: summary
inputs.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (stage count, first and last stage, overall conversion, largest drop).

inputs.name: valueFormat
inputs.description: Number format for stage values in labels, accessible names, the tooltip, the data table, and the summary. Conversions are always percentages with at most one fraction digit.

inputs.name: stages
inputs.description: Stages in order: { id, label, value: number | null, color?: 1-8 }. Ids are unique and non-empty; values are non-negative; null, NaN, and infinities are a missing stage (read "No value").

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: Palette slot for every stage without its own color.

inputs.name: theme
inputs.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

inputs.name: renderTooltip
inputs.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

inputs.name: syncGroup
inputs.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair, highlight, and tooltip at the same column (category or x index) when one of them is hovered or focused. Focus never moves between charts. Use charts that share their categories or x values.

inputs.name: legend
inputs.description: Shared chart configuration; a funnel never shows a legend (stages are labelled beside their bars).

inputs.name: dataTable
inputs.description: Data table fallback (Stage, Value, Of first stage, Of previous stage): behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

inputs.name: tooltip
inputs.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus (value, of first stage, of previous stage).

inputs.name: patterns
inputs.description: Shared chart configuration; toggles the aui-chart--patterns host class. Funnel stages draw no textures (there is one series).

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000), divided evenly between stages; the width follows the container.

inputs.name: showConversion
inputs.description: Print the conversion from the previous stage next to each stage value ("400 | 40%"). Accessible names, the tooltip, and the table always include conversions.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: rtl moves stage names and values to the right side and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

models.name: hiddenSeries
models.description: Shared chart option; validated but has no effect (a funnel has no toggleable series).

outputs.name: pointClicked
outputs.description: A data mark was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused mark. label is the category, x value, or item; value is the formatted value text. Keyboard navigation is unchanged.

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Shared chart method; re-renders but has no visible effect on a funnel. Emits no event.

accessibility.pattern: SVG funnel chart as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "funnel chart") of role="img" stage bars with roving focus; data table fallback (native table: Stage, Value, Of first stage, Of previous stage).

limitations: One funnel per chart; no legend (each stage is labelled beside its bar).
Conversion is computed against the previous stage that has a value; missing stages are skipped.
Conversions are not computed when the first (or previous) stage is zero or missing; those stages read only their value.
The legend, patterns, and hiddenSeries options are accepted (shared chart options) but have no visible effect: there are no series to toggle or texture.
